name: CSS Toggle Switch
description: Accessible, CSS-only, toggle switches form elements.
project_description:
Integrates the CSS Toggle Switch library (ghinda/css-toggle-switch) to provide configurable, accessible, CSS-only switch form elements built from standard radio controls.

CSS Toggle Switches are a set of accessible CSS-only switch components created from standard form controls in the markup, so they degrade gracefully and work without JavaScript. The switch behaviour and appearance is driven entirely by CSS classes, and the styles can be used standalone or alongside Bootstrap or Foundation.

The module ships a reusable 'toggle_switch' Form API element (extending core Radios) that can be used programmatically, plus a matching Better Exposed Filters widget for Views exposed filters and an optional Webform submodule that adds 'Toggle Switch' and 'Entity Toggle Switch' Webform elements.
